subject: RE: Urgent: Erasure request for tenant NL-472 — scope and confirmation
content:
From: Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@northleaf.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Erasure request for tenant NL-472 — immediate scope

Hi Soojin,

Per our compliance audit, we need Redwood to permanently remove all prompt inputs, model outputs, and transient inference logs associated with our tenant NL-472 (EU region). Our legal team has requested completion within 48 hours if possible and a deletion manifest.

Scope we require removed:
- All prompt_text and derived assistant outputs (user messages, assistant replies) stored in prompt logs.
- Any KV-cache derivatives and ephemeral caches tied to NL-472.
- Request/response traces and request-level metadata retained for <90 days — we are asking for immediate removal now.
- Any scheduled backups that may contain these artifacts (S3/backup buckets).

Please confirm whether Redwood can run a full purge for NL-472 within 48 hours and provide an auditable manifest and proof of wipe (checksums / ops runbook). If 48h is not feasible, propose earliest completion time and required acceptance steps on our side.

Thanks,
Jorge
Jorge Alvarez
Head of Platform Ops, Northleaf Finance

+44 20 7946 0XXX

Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Erasure request for tenant NL-472 — immediate scope

Hi Jorge — thanks for the clear scope. We can run a targeted purge but need to align on three operational items before we start:

1) Exact account/tenant identifier: confirm NL-472 is the Redwood tenant id (we have NL-472 and NL-472-SBX variants).
2) Scope confirmation: please explicitly confirm you want BOTH prompt inputs AND model outputs removed (we treat prompts and outputs as distinct artifacts in our retention system).
3) Legal acceptance for accelerated window: for 48-hour SLA we require an executed acceptance form acknowledging non-recoverability and that you waive rollback for 30 days (DocuSign link).

Operational notes:
- Standard purge window is 72 hours for EU runs to allow snapshotting and internal signing.
- We will provide an erase_manifest.csv with object IDs, timestamps, and a signed ops checklist.
- Purge will be executed by Infra Ops (Connor) and coordinated with CS (Lauren) for customer communication.

If you can confirm tenant id and sign the attached acceptance (DocuSign), Connor can book an accelerated slot tonight (EU maintenance window).

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@northleaf.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Erasure request for tenant NL-472 — immediate scope

Thanks — tagging in operations. Jorge, summary of how we execute (high level):

Planned steps (ops runbook):
- Snapshot current production metadata for NL-472 (for provenance) and store read-only in secure vault for 30 days before final purge — snapshot will not contain prompt/output payloads, only identifiers and hashes.
- Run deletion jobs across the following stores:
  * Prompt logs (prompt_text, user metadata) — TTL delete + object purge
  * Output logs (assistant replies, generation artifacts) — object purge with zeroing of content
  * KV-caches and ephemeral LRU caches — purge and invalidate entries
  * Backup buckets: identify objects with NL-472 prefix and perform S3 delete markers and lifecycle truncation
- Run integrity sweep to ensure no leakage into derived indexes (embedding indexes, reranking caches).
- Produce erase_manifest_20270402.csv containing a line-per-object with object_id, path, delete_timestamp, and SHA256-delete-marker.
- Attach ops-checklist-erase.pdf describing verification steps executed by on-call for audit.

ETA options:
- Standard: 72 hours from confirmation (we schedule within our EU maintenance window to minimize impact).
- Accelerated: 48 hours if DocuSign acceptance is returned and we allocate a dedicated operator slot tonight (additional fee may apply, please confirm).

Please confirm tenant exact id and whether you accept the accelerated terms. Once we have DocuSign signed, I will create the ticket and kick off the first deletion pass.

Attachment: ops-checklist-erase.pdf (see attached runbook checklist)

Regards,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Infra Operations Engineer
Connor.OBrien@redwoodinference.com

Jorge — purge completed and verified. Summary of delivery below and attached artifacts:

- Purge window executed: 2027-04-02 22:05:00 UTC -> 2027-04-02 23:48:00 UTC
- Objects removed: 18,432 prompt/output objects and 1,102 cache entries associated with NL-472
- Backups: Identified 12 S3 objects with NL-472 prefix, deleted with delete markers and lifecycle accelerated (no remaining replicas).

Deliverables attached:
- erase_manifest_20270402.csv (line-per-object: object_id, path, delete_timestamp, delete_sha256_marker) [Attachment]
- ops-checklist-erase.pdf (signed by on-call engineer) [Attachment]
- docusign-northleaf-erasure-signed.pdf (DocuSign envelope snapshot) [Attachment]

Proof notes:
- Each line in erase_manifest includes SHA256(delete_marker) which we store in our audit ledger. We retain the ledger entry (hash metadata only) for 90 days per our compliance playbook; the underlying content is irrecoverable.
- Verification: Integrity sweep completed and embedded-index scan returned zero records referencing NL-472 keys.

Operational links:
- Manifest (drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEF_manifest
- HubSpot ticket: HS-39284
- DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-123

If you need a notarized attestation or formal certificate for audit, we can produce a signed attestation document (additional steps). Otherwise please reply ACK to confirm acceptance of the manifest and closure.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
